name: linear-tree
description: A Claude Code mod: a Linear project as a tree and a flowchart in a side pane, with progress, search, filters, shortcuts and markers on the issues agents are working on.

defaultProject.title: Default project
defaultProject.description: The Linear project /tree shows when none is named and none was shown before. Empty (default): /tree asks which project to show.

linearServer.title: Linear server
linearServer.description: The Linear MCP server's name as /mcp lists it. Empty (default): the server whose list_issues tool is Linear's, then "claude.ai Linear", "Linear" and "linear".

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: While the pane is shown, reload the tree this often; 0 turns it off (default 5).
